disposition_reason: Tables 1 and 2 print mean element concentrations (mg/kg dry) in dough and baked Barbari, Lavash and Sangak breads from traditional and industrial bakeries in Mashhad; lead and mercury were below detection in all samples.

study.design: Cross-sectional bakery survey with before/after baking and oven-type comparison
study.origin: bakeries in Mashhad, Khorasan Razavi, Iran
study.market: 90 traditional and industrial bakeries, 5 municipal districts of Mashhad
study.method: Oven drying at 100 C, HNO3/HCl microwave digestion (EPA 3050B), ICP-OES (Spectro Arcos)
lod: ug/L in solution: Fe 0.06, Cu 0.1, Zn 0.1, Ni 0.12, As 0.2, V 0.06, Co 0.02, Pb 0.5, Hg 0.18, Al 0.38, Cr 0.06; Cd not listed
study.qa: CRM rice flour IRMM 804 and spiked solutions; recoveries 87-112%; triplicate analysis

findings.notes: 90 bakeries in 5 districts of Mashhad, Iran, October to December 2020; oven-dried at 100 C, HNO3/HCl microwave digestion (EPA 3050B), ICP-OES; dry-weight basis. CRM rice flour IRMM 804, recoveries 87-112%. Table header gives n=60 per bread type (dough and bread combined across ovens); per-cell n not printed. SD printed after mean.
